publish.description: Lossless Scaling frame generation (LSFG 3.1) and scaling (LS1, FSR) on the Steam Deck, each on its own or together, with a per-game toggle, live status and Lossless Scaling's own settings. Uses your own copy of Lossless Scaling; built on a modified MAKO Renderer layer (GPL). Not affiliated with Lossless Scaling (THS), AMD, MAKO or Valve.
